spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership remains backend-enforced. This reads stored per-item projections; resales of the same copy may be overwritten and unimported sales remain unknown.
Preserve soldAtBasis, source and projection clocks, price provenance, refunds and conflicts. A stored sale is not proof of shipment, provider verification, new-write completion or profit.

The sale-time bin is historical. Buyer identity and raw pricing payloads are omitted. Follow pages before describing returned history; separate changing pages do not provide a transaction-wide snapshot.

description: Read a workspace page of recorded sales with card identity, recorded marketplace and order reference, sale-time bin, gross price, refunds and source clocks. Use it to inspect saved sales after inventory or sale activity. Follow nextCursor for more recorded history; use current pull work to inspect packing tasks.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this workspace's previous page. Pass unchanged; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum sale projections on this page. Omit for the default page size.

workspaceId.description: The workspace from workspaces discovery whose recorded sales to read. Required.

name: spellbook_sales_history
